title: Headless sprint loop 2: intake drafts, land windows and worker cost
goal: A headless Sonnet worker's usage counts as its item's cost and land's no-work-rows warning tells a late row from a missing one; the intake hook files a finding once, in any checkout, and respects the open-draft cap; land moves intake drafts aside in the checkout it runs in, and the docs say what land does with drafts in a worktree made elsewhere; a background land closes its window only once it pushed, reading done from origin/main; cost --rework prints its no-capture line and no zero tables, and the review step words zeros by their cause; land waits a bounded time for a finished worker's SessionEnd hook, and selfcheck names a young distill process as a hook
